record.question: Determining budget can be best described by which of the following?
options: The process of developing the future trends along with the assessment of probabilities, uncertainties, and inflation that could occur during the project
The process of accumulating costs of individual activities to establish a cost baseline.
The process of establishing budgets, standards, and a monitoring system by which the investment cost of the project can be measured and managed
The process of gathering, accumulating, analyzing, reporting, and managing the costs on an ongoing basis
